description: French rental limits by DPE class: letting ban, rent freeze, DPE validity. · Restrictions locatives selon la classe DPE : interdiction de louer, gel des loyers, validité du DPE. — Given a dwelling's DPE class (A–G), returns the French rental restrictions in force: letting ban status and date (loi n° 2021-1104 Climat et Résilience — G banned since 2025, F from 2028, E from 2034, France métropolitaine), the F/G rent freeze (no rent revision in a class F or G dwelling — loi n° 89-462 art. 17-1, III, for leases concluded, renewed or tacitly continued since 24 August 2022), and — when dpe_issue_date is provided — whether the DPE itself is still valid (10-year rule + the 2013–2021 transitional expiries). Deterministic rules from official thresholds — no AI involved.

dpe_class.description: Energy class from the dwelling's DPE.

dpe_issue_date.description: ISO issue date of the DPE — enables the validity check.

name: check_dpe_rental_restrictions
title: DPE rental restrictions — letting ban, rent freeze, DPE validity
